changes.title: Each service shows its photo, and the button names the next step
changes.why: Choices with no picture feel like a form, and a button that only says Continue does not say what comes next (video lessons: the picture appears when a thing is named; the button names the next step).

changes.title: What we kasher: both services with photos, extras in one slim row
changes.why: Now the whole kitchen has no photo while the pots do, the section is far taller than a screen, and the Jerusalem price note repeats four times (page rules 3c, 3s: same kind shown the same way, one screen).

changes.title: Real numbers shown big: 2019, 6 parts, 2 hours, 2 languages
changes.why: The facts are buried in a small table; the owner's own numbers read faster when large (page rules 3s.14).

changes.title: A Pages menu on the home page, so every page can be reached
changes.why: The home page bar only lists the kitchen parts, so on a phone there is no way to the other pages except by scrolling (page rules 3k: one menu bar on every page).

changes.title: The booking summary shows on phones, with a bin on every line
changes.why: On a phone the summary is hidden, so nothing could be removed; now each line has its photo, price and a remove button (page rules 3k).

changes.title: The last button says what happens and the total: Send on WhatsApp, $530
changes.why: The final button should name the action and the amount so there is no surprise (page rules 3s.17).

questions: Do you want to offer a lower price when someone books the whole kitchen and the pots and cutlery together? Right now there is no saving to show, so we show none.
Do you have a promise or guarantee we can state next to the Book button (for example, we come back if something is not right)? If not, we say nothing.
Is there a travel fee outside Jerusalem, and how much, or does it depend on the place? We only say there may be one.
Can you send photos of your own work (a kitchen being kashered, mashgichim at work)? The kitchen picture now is a generated setting, not yours.
Is there a phone number or email we can show beside WhatsApp?
checks_now: On the real site: check-site found no broken pages but buttons that did not react to hover or press, station buttons under 40 px on phones, logo without a size, and motion-off notes; check-fits found the What we kasher, For guests and Book sections, and the kitchen and pots page tops, taller than a short laptop screen; check-motion passed. The copy fixes all of these except two motion-off notes that look like a false alarm on the pinned opening.
